key_insight: The neural basis method separates fixed neural representations from physics-based coefficient determination to solve and learn Navier–Stokes dynamics.
engineering_relevance: Shared basis coordinates enable parameter-to-coefficient learning without explicit spatial inputs, offering a scalable approach to parametric flow prediction.
method: Define the solution space using fixed neural basis functions.
Project governing equations onto this space to determine expansion coefficients.
Learn parameter-to-coefficient maps using a velocity-only residual with an a posteriori velocity-error estimate.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical analysis and numerical experiments showing improvements over baselines in accuracy, efficiency, generalization, and scalability, but gives no quantitative results.
watch_item: Performance may depend on how well the fixed neural bases represent flows beyond the evaluated parameter regimes.
paper_title: Solving and Learning Navier-Stokes Dynamics with the Neural Basis Method
